lead.title: TRiCares meets the primary endpoint of its European TRICURE pivotal trial: the Topaz tricuspid valve targets CE mark in 2027
lead.deck: Presented on Nov. 23 in a Top Late-Breaking Trials session at PCR London Valves, 30-day data from TRICURE EU (77 patients with severe tricuspid regurgitation, 24 sites in six European countries, principal investigator Jörg Hausleiter, LMU Munich) show the primary endpoint met in 98% of patients — regurgitation reduced by at least one grade and no worse than moderate — with a 15.6% major adverse event rate, 5% new pacemakers and a 32-minute average implant time. For this privately held French-German medtech (Andera, Wellington Partners, Bayern Kapital, Karista, BioMed Partners…), it is the dataset meant to support a CE mark filing and a European launch next year, while the US IDE trial enrolls at up to 75 sites.

milestone.title: InnovHeart presents first European results for Saturn, its transseptal mitral valve, at PCR London Valves
milestone.summary: In the CASSINI-EU study, presented by Milan surgeon Paolo Denti, 15 high-risk patients with functional mitral regurgitation ≥3+ were treated: 93.3% technical success (one surgical conversion after a delivery-system component failure), MR ≤1+ in all 14 patients evaluated at 30 days, and no cardiovascular death, disabling stroke or reintervention. The KCCQ quality-of-life score rose from 42.9 to 70.1.
milestone.why: Transseptal mitral replacement remains structural heart's holy grail, held back by the risk of left ventricular outflow tract obstruction: Saturn's low-profile system, which captures the anterior leaflet, targets precisely that bottleneck. For a privately held Italian-American company still at feasibility stage, these data open the door to larger studies.

brefsEurope.title: AI brain-bleed detection tool co-developed by CGI and Helsinki University Hospital certified Class IIb under MDR
brefsEurope.summary: CGI AI Head Analysis, built with HUS and Planmeca under neurosurgeon Miikka Korja, flags suspected spontaneous intracranial hemorrhages on head CT for physician review. With its MDR Class IIb certification announced Nov. 24, it can now be integrated directly into emergency imaging workflows — a rare case of hospital-born AI industrialized by an IT services group.

brefsEurope.title: Heraeus pulls nitinol vascular guidewires over hydrophilic coating detachment risk
brefsEurope.summary: The German component maker told customers to immediately stop using and distributing certain lots of Arrow, Navilyst and Spectrum guidewires: their hydrophilic coating can swell unevenly when hydrated with saline and detach, risking embolism. The FDA posted an early alert; no serious injuries or deaths had been reported as of Nov. 5 — a recall that hits the OEM brands Heraeus supplies.

brefsEurope.title: Riverside invests in Lyon-area contract manufacturer Medical Group, which teams up with Selenium Medical
brefsEurope.summary: The US firm takes a stake, off-market, in this medical device CDMO (surface treatment, hydroxyapatite coatings, cleanroom, sterile packaging), mainly serving orthopedics and dental, while a partnership with La Rochelle-based Selenium Medical creates a one-stop shop. It is Riverside's fifth healthcare deal in France, with a European acquisition program to follow.

brefsEurope.title: British Business Bank invests £43M in Oxford Science Enterprises, Oxford's spinout engine
brefsEurope.summary: It is the UK state bank's first investment in OSE, which turns University of Oxford research into startups (life sciences, healthtech, deeptech); the deal is meant to ease co-investment and give portfolio companies access to BBB's long-term capital. A signal for the university spinout pipeline — nearly six in ten European medical device startups come from it, according to AlbionVC.

brefsIntl.title: NEXTBIOMEDICAL completes procedures for all 126 patients in its FDA pivotal knee embolization trial
brefsIntl.summary: The randomized RESORB trial compares genicular artery embolization using Nexsphere-F resorbable microspheres with corticosteroid injections in knee osteoarthritis; outcomes are assessed at 6 and 12 months, with an FDA filing aimed at 2028 approval. A comparable for musculoskeletal embolization, interventional radiology's new frontier.

brefsIntl.title: Renerva completes 3-month follow-up in first-in-human study of its Terminus nerve cap
brefsIntl.summary: Made from porcine nerve extracellular matrix to prevent painful neuroma formation, the device was implanted in four patients at Ohio State University (IDE G250147) with no device-related adverse events; pain and disability trended favorably, in a very small, uncontrolled sample.

word.full: MDR Annex VIII, Classification Rule 11 (software classification rule)
word.fr: Rule 11 of the EU Medical Device Regulation
word.definition: The EU MDR rule that sets a medical software's risk class by the severity of the decisions it informs: Class IIa by default, IIb if an error could cause serious deterioration of health or a surgical intervention, III if it could cause death.

parts.label: Intended purpose
parts.role: what the software informs: diagnosis, therapy or monitoring

parts.label: Severity
parts.role: the impact of an error on the patient, which raises the class

parts.label: Notified body
parts.role: the mandatory auditor from Class IIa upward

how.t: The manufacturer first checks, using MDCG 2019-11 guidance, that its software has a medical purpose and falls under the MDR.
It applies Rule 11: diagnostic support software is at least IIa; detecting a brain bleed or occlusion, where delay can be serious, pushes it to IIb.
A notified body audits the quality system and clinical documentation before issuing the certificate that allows CE marking.

word.why: Under the MDR, Rule 11 moved almost all medical software from Class I self-certification to notified-body audits: cost and delays that weigh on a medical-AI startup's funding plan. For a VC, the target class (IIa or IIb) sizes the clinical evidence required, the time to market and the barrier to entry against competitors — today's Class IIb certification for the CGI–Helsinki University Hospital tool is a case in point.

startups.name: Avicenna.AI
startups.use: Its CINA CT triage algorithms (intracranial hemorrhage, large vessel occlusion, pulmonary embolism) are MDR-certified by BSI; partnered with Bracco for the FDA

startups.name: Methinks AI
startups.use: Its CE-marked Stroke Suite detects large vessel occlusions and hemorrhages on non-contrast CT; backed by the EIC Accelerator

startups.name: Cerebriu
startups.use: Its CE-marked Apollo AI spots infarcts, hemorrhages and tumors during brain MRI and adapts the protocol in real time, embedded in Siemens Healthineers consoles
